Game Overview

In Mad Fish, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Mad Fish, an exhilarating arcade quest where survival hinges on strategy and reflexes. Navigate through a dynamic ocean, gobbling up smaller fish while evading larger predators. Team up with friends for a thrilling multiplayer experience, striving to become the ocean’s ultimate sea creature.
